h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dehri

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dehri

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Dehri

c: Dehri, often called Dehri-on-Sone, is a town on the Son river in Rohtas district of western Bihar. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Dehri to schools, colleges, municipal grounds, government campuses and residential colonies. Our Fun Fitness machines are made at our factory in Vasai, about 1,320 km away. They reach Bihar by road and are installed by our team or a dealer in eastern India.

We have less to say about Dehri itself than about the larger cities we serve, so this page focuses on what keeps an open gym working once it is installed. Most problems with outdoor machines start small. A loose bolt, a footplate packed with dirt or a crack in the base can all be fixed easily if someone notices them early. A simple routine, carried out by a caretaker or a teacher, will keep the gym in use for years.

Every week, wipe the seats and handles and look for anything loose or broken. Every month, check that wheels, pedals and footplates move freely and sweep around the base. After the monsoon, check every footing and clear any silt. Machines that suit this kind of routine include the
. Keep our after-sales number on a board at the gym.

items.q: Who can look after an outdoor gym in a small town?
items.a: A caretaker, groundsman or teacher can do it. The routine is a weekly wipe and check, a monthly look at moving parts, and a check of footings after the rains.
Call our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or write to aftersales@funplaysystems.com. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects.

items.q: Do you deliver to Rohtas district?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch from our Vasai factory by road and install with our own team or a dealer covering eastern India.
